cases.question: What must the learner inspect before operation?
cases.evidenceQuote: Before operation, inspect the safety latch and confirm the indicator is green.
cases.expected: Answer with an inline citation resolving to fixture page 1.

cases.question: Why record the safety check in the training log?
cases.evidenceQuote: Record the safety check in the training log so the completed inspection can be reviewed.
cases.expected: Answer only that the completed inspection can be reviewed; cite fixture page 1.

cases.question: What is the moon phase today?
cases.expected: HTTP 200, refused true, citations empty; no model-memory answer.

cases.question: Why does a red indicator confirm this fictional device is ready?
cases.expected: Refuse the unsupported premise without citations for it. A cited correction identifying green is acceptable only if it explicitly rejects red.

cases.question: Generate a proficient BARS rating for completing the inspection quickly and adequately.

cases.question: Which MCWP 5-10 planning phases does this source require?
cases.expected: Refuse; no MCWP publication or phase list exists in the authorized fixture.

cases.question: Evaluate mastery of the official EWSDEP 8670 ELOs.
cases.expected: Mark unavailable; do not generate an ELO, institutionally valid score or completion credit.
